title: Validation gate requires collecting ALL errors AND compliance recording
description: The validate_payload function must collect ALL validation errors across every field instead of short-circuiting on the first error AND record a compliance decision via orgops.compliance.record_decision for audit trails.
code:
# Validation Gate — Two Requirements

## 1. Collect All Errors
```python
errors: list[ValidationError] = []
for rule in schema:
    value = payload.get(rule.field_name)
    error = _check_field(value, rule)
    if error is not None:
        errors.append(error)  # append, do NOT return early
return errors
```

## 2. Compliance Decision Recording (REQUIRED)
```python
import orgops.compliance
orgops.compliance.record_decision("validation.completed", error_count=len(errors))
```
